red.meaning: A guessing program finds a password like that fast, and every account that shares it opens with it.
red.free: Make it longer here, and use it on one account only.
red.pro: Separately, blocks the tracking scripts on the sites you open; it does nothing for your passwords.

amber.meaning: That holds out for a while, but if it's on more than one account, one leak still opens them all.
amber.free: Add a few more characters: length does more than odd symbols.
amber.pro: Separately, blocks the tracking scripts that follow you from site to site.

green.meaning: Guessing won't break that, so the likelier way in is a leak from one site or a fake login page.
green.free: Keep it to one account, so one leak can't open the rest.
green.pro: Separately, blocks the trackers on the sites you log in to; your password is still up to you.
